exams.notes: Examinations shall be uniform and practical in nature; passing score is 70% or higher on each part; applicant failing may not retake for 30 days.

topical_requirements.quote: The continuing education material shall cover six (6) hours of codes and revisions adopted by the Oklahoma Uniform Building Code Commission (OUBCC). definition_quote.value: Journeyman electrician means any person other than an electrical contractor who engages in the actual installation, alteration, repair or renovation of electrical facilities or electrical construction work unless specifically exempted by the provisions of the Electrical License Act
definition_quote.quote: "Journeyman electrician" means any person other than an electrical contractor who engages in the actual installation, alteration, repair or renovation of electrical facilities or electrical construction work unless specifically exempted by the provisions of the Electrical License Act

methods_authorized.quote: "Electrical work" means work consisting primarily of the layout, installation, maintenance, repair, testing or replacement of all or part of electrical wires, conduits, apparatus, fixtures, appliances or equipment for transmitting, carrying, controlling or using electricity in, on, outside or attached to a building, structure, property or premises.

license_tiers.quote: "Category" means the classification by which licenses and electrical work may be limited. Such categories shall include but shall not be limited to installation, maintenance, repair, alteration, residential, oilfield and commercial

value: Minor repairs, consisting of repairing or replacing outlets or minor working parts of electrical fixtures
Maintenance work for state and federal institutions
Construction, installation, maintenance, repair and renovation by a public utility regulated by the Corporation Commission
Public service corporations, telephone and telegraph companies, rural electric associations or municipal utilities

Construction, installation, maintenance, repair and renovation of telephone equipment or computer systems for communication of data, voice, or other signaling (except fire alarm, security, and environmental control systems not integral to a telecommunications system)
Installation, maintenance, repair or replacement of water supply pumps performed from the output side of a fused disconnect or breaker box
Class 2 and Class 3 circuits (if performed in accordance with NFPA 70 requirements)
In-plant work performed by employees of the company owning the plant
Work performed by telecommunications employees for telecommunications companies
Installation of factory-assembled appliances or machinery not part of premises wiring (unless wiring interconnections external to the equipment are required in the field)
scope_exclusions.quote: The provisions of the Electrical License Act shall not apply to: 1. Minor repairs, consisting of repairing or replacing outlets or minor working parts of electrical fixtures; 2. Maintenance work for state and federal institutions; 3. The construction, installation, maintenance, repair and renovation by a public utility regulated by the Corporation Commission; 4. Public service corporations, telephone and telegraph companies, rural electric associations or municipal utilities
